Test-only SQL injects nonexistent message refs into mentions and object link and rejects with OFFICE_MENTION_MESSAGE_INTEGRITY_INVALID and OFFICE_OBJECT_MESSAGE_INTEGRITY_INVALID; transaction ends ROLLBACK.
Full isolated PG69 clean replay, official pre/postflight, existing Office reply negative paths, all customer unit regressions, typecheck and Plan/Knowledge/Replay/risk PASS.
invariants: Only local ephemeral PG DB is ever used; remote PGHOST ignored.
Team Chat private mentions/object links cannot be selected directly by browser roles.
Missing message/integrity trigger must fail closed.
Unique active owner constraint present and service-only transfer RPC is never public.
No test fixture rows or temp PostgreSQL process remain afterward.
No product SQL history mutated; native Supabase actor claims remain blocked.
forbiddenStates: Source-only mention checks reported actual database RLS proof without SET ROLE.

challenge.scenario: Anonymous browser queries office_message_mentions on empty store using SELECT count(*).
challenge.finding: If grant/RLS is accidentally broadened, mention user IDs leak despite source checks.
challenge.resolution: Execute SELECT after SET ROLE anon and require actual Postgres permission denied.

challenge.scenario: Authenticated browser queries office_message_object_links directly without private thread membership.
challenge.finding: Business object metadata could disclose private group commercial activities across tenants.
challenge.resolution: Execute SELECT after SET ROLE authenticated and require actual permission denied.

challenge.scenario: Admin disables office_message_mentions_integrity trigger while leaving SQL source unchanged.
challenge.finding: Malformed mentions can be inserted from service-role worker; source assertion would falsely PASS.
challenge.resolution: Require tgenabled=O and BEFORE INSERT/UPDATE bits from pg_trigger each fresh replay.

challenge.scenario: Admin removes partial unique active owner index.
challenge.finding: Concurrent group owner operations can create duplicate active owners.
challenge.resolution: Query pg_index unique/partial metadata for canonical index; fail rehearsal if absent.

challenge.finding: Ownership could be seized without server-side entitlement checks.
challenge.resolution: Test has_function_privilege false for anon/authenticated and true for service_role.

challenge.scenario: Privileged service worker inserts mention for random message ID absent from this tenant.
challenge.finding: Message identity integrity must not accept orphan mentions before FK check.
challenge.resolution: Rollback-only test insert must raise exact OFFICE_MENTION_MESSAGE_INTEGRITY_INVALID from the trigger.

challenge.scenario: Privileged service worker inserts object link for random message ID absent from this tenant.
challenge.finding: Invalid business link may be persisted without source message or author.
challenge.resolution: Rollback-only test insert must raise exact OFFICE_OBJECT_MESSAGE_INTEGRITY_INVALID.

challenge.scenario: Rehearsal throws before SQL negative test and leaves trust PG server alive.
challenge.finding: Local server resources and socket permissions could leak.
challenge.resolution: Keep try/finally stop and rmSync on exception; no TCP listen and private chmod 700 socket.

operationalIntelligence.problemStatement: Fresh Install 0065-0067 Team Chat 2 schema, table-boundary triggers and owner transfer all install on local PostgreSQL 18, but F19 reusable real-PG harness still checks browser RLS and direct EXECUTE only for earlier Office tables and reply job. That leaves Team Chat mention/object table ACL, enabled triggers, active owner uniqueness, service-only RPC grants, and actual malformed message/link direct SQL untested. Extend only test fixtures and isolated opt-in PG harness with effective role negative SELECT checks, real pg_trigger/pg_index catalogs and rollback-only insert negatives for non-existent message; do not modify customer SQL or call hosted Supabase.
observableOutcomes: On every F19 PG rehearsal, assert Office Team Chat mentions and object link tables have RLS and that anon/authenticated cannot read either by SET ROLE.
Inspect actual pg_trigger metadata for both mention/object before INSERT+UPDATE triggers enabled, plus active-owner partial unique index.
Check admin_transfer_office_thread_owner_v1 EXECUTE denied to anon/authenticated and allowed service_role; do not claim caller JWT binding.
Execute transactional SQL negative probes which attempt insert mentions and object links referencing non-existent message IDs and require exact canonical exception names, followed by ROLLBACK.
No permanent mock data left in target DB or PostgreSQL process, no production SQL changes.
Maintain original 69/69 PG migration + auth bootstrap/seed/postflight, 144+ regressions and Control Plane/Release Risk 2/5 PASS.
unresolvedRisks: Nonexistent-message negative inserts do not prove authorized valid team-chat send, race/owner transfer, cross-tenant row access or session identity; add native full-feature test later.

Runner changes can accidentally leak a long-running PostgreSQL instance or misparse role output; preserve isolation and fail-closed cleanup.
